localEquivalence.result: no /v1/audio/speech path reaches Deepgram today; this module is the whole TTS delta. The generic FORMAT_HANDLERS.deepgram is a same-name config, not an equivalent, and stays untouched

exports.deepgramTtsAdapter: default TTS adapter instance; synthesize(text, model, credentials, responseFormat, options)
exports.createDeepgramTtsAdapter: factory; options { fetchImpl, timeoutMs, maxAudioBytes } for tests
exports.buildDeepgramSpeechRequest: (model, text, options) -> { url, body }; throws status 400
exports.resolveDeepgramContainer: (...namedFormats) -> "mp3"; throws status 400 for anything but mp3/json
exports.isMp3: (bytes) leading-byte check: ID3 tag or MPEG layer III frame sync
exports.listDeepgramTtsModels: async (credentials, { fetchImpl, signal, timeoutMs, maxBytes }) -> { models } or an error result; bounded GET /v1/models
exports.parseDeepgramTtsModels: (payload) -> Aura speech model rows from a /v1/models answer
exports.groupDeepgramVoices: (models) -> { languages, byLang }, the dashboard voices route shape
exports.deepgramAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.DEEPGRAM_TTS_DEFINITION: speech fields to merge into the existing deepgram registry entry (addServiceKinds, ttsConfig)

models.acceptedIds: the three rows plus any id matching DEEPGRAM_TTS_MODEL_PATTERN (Aura-1 and Aura-2 voices from discovery); the model is the voice
models.dynamicDiscovery: the source has none; listDeepgramTtsModels is a bounded version of the existing dashboard voices route (GET https://api.deepgram.com/v1/models, tts[].canonical_name)

speech.answer: audio/mpeg bytes; dg-char-count and dg-request-id headers read when present

discovery.answer: { stt: [...], tts: [{ name, canonical_name, languages, metadata.tags }] }
